divergences.summary: Final_Sigma context in py_lower uses std's Unicode 17 Cased/Case_Ignorable sets; a sigma next to U+0295 or a character newly cased in Unicode 17 can lower differently from CPython 3.14 (decamelize("ʕΣ") is "ʕς" in Python, "ʕσ" here)
divergences.rationale: Review finding 2 residual. Per-character case mappings and the str predicates are matched to CPython 3.14 with generated tables; reproducing Final_Sigma would need CPython's Cased and Case_Ignorable sets, which unicodedata does not expose. No fixture input contains these characters.
divergences.approvedBy: unattended: no user answer covers this residual; conservative choice is to fix every probe-confirmed mapping and declare only the sigma-context residual
